why_this_scope: Builds one complete scoped frame before national scale; small enough to debug semantics, geocoding, exclusion policy, and estimator scripts end to end.
required_inputs: One Geofabrik state or subregion source; public-post-office seed extraction; seed-semantics filter; settlement join; target-box build; sidecar/depth workflow; frame manifest.
implementation_steps: Select one state/subregion stratum; extract all reviewed public post-office seeds; filter semantics; build all target boxes; run sidecars/current-anchor/depth on every eligible target; build full-frame denominator and estimator dry run.
validation_gates: Frame row count reconciles from raw seed to eligible public-post-office frame; every frame target has denominator status; all numerator candidates have truth dossiers; exclusion ledger reconciles to frame total.
allowed_output: Exact target-box share for the selected scoped stratum after full-frame review, labeled only to that scope.
blocked_output: National frequency, regional frequency outside the selected frame, confidence intervals, or smallest-postal-parish claims.
recommendation: Use as first implementation path; pick a tractable stratum with current Geofabrik availability and manageable seed count.

why_this_scope: Tests probability machinery on one explicit frame without reviewing every target, but requires weights, inclusion probabilities, nonresponse/exclusion handling, and variance estimator before any frequency output.
required_inputs: Complete frame manifest for one stratum; sampling seed; sample size; inclusion probability formula; estimator spec; sidecar/depth workflow for sampled rows.
implementation_steps: Build stratum frame; draw sample using versioned seed; compute pi and weights; review sampled targets; estimate weighted candidate share and uncertainty only if source gates are acceptable.
validation_gates: Sample draw is reproducible; every sampled row has pi and weight; source-gated/excluded share below predeclared threshold; variance estimator script validates.
allowed_output: Design-based estimate for the selected stratum only, if all gates pass.
blocked_output: National frequency or unweighted prevalence from sampled rows.
recommendation: Use after single-stratum full-frame path if full review is too large or if sampling mechanics are the priority.

why_this_scope: Moves toward regional/national inference but requires frame sizes, strata, allocation, weights, and source-gate policy across multiple scopes.
required_inputs: Frame manifests for all selected strata; allocation plan; sampling seed; inclusion probabilities; estimator/variance scripts; nonresponse/exclusion policy.
implementation_steps: Build each stratum frame; assign strata; allocate sample; draw rows; review sampled targets; estimate weighted pooled and stratum shares only after all gates pass.
validation_gates: Every selected stratum has finite population count, sample count, pi, weight, and source-gate summary; pooled estimator reconciles to strata.
allowed_output: Multi-stratum estimate for declared combined frame only.
blocked_output: National claim if national frame is incomplete; stratum claims with inadequate sample/source gates.
recommendation: Defer until one scoped frame implementation is proven.

why_this_scope: Most direct route to national exact target-box frequency, but likely large and operationally expensive because every eligible public-post-office target needs sidecars, current-anchor gates, depth review, and exclusions.
required_inputs: National public-post-office frame; nationwide Geofabrik/state extracts; semantics filter; settlement join; full sidecar/depth pipeline; denominator/exclusion/estimator scripts.
implementation_steps: Enumerate national frame state by state; build all target boxes; execute source sidecars and current-anchor gates; truth-dossier every numerator candidate; compute exact full-frame share.
validation_gates: All state frame counts reconcile; denominator/exclusion ledger covers entire frame; every numerator candidate has decision; source-gate share is acceptable or sensitivity bounded.
allowed_output: Exact national public-post-office target-box share if fully executed and validated.
blocked_output: National claim before complete frame review; catchment/service-absence claims.
recommendation: Do not start here unless resources are available for full national execution.

why_this_scope: Useful for discovery and narrative recurrence but does not advance probability/full-frame inference by itself.
required_inputs: New versioned breadth manifest; source-gate controls; same sidecar/depth workflow.
implementation_steps: Select new manifest rows; execute deterministic target samples; report bounded selected-wave results.
validation_gates: Denominator and dossier validators pass for the new selected wave.
allowed_output: Additional descriptive selected-wave exemplars and pattern recurrence.
blocked_output: Probability, regional, stratum, or national frequency.
recommendation: Use only if discovery is the priority over inferential design.
